purpose: Deterministic field->object_id binding for the slide-2 exec-summary/thesis. Grok pulls VALUES from narrative-slide2-<partner>.json (DISTILLED from the proposal, never authored) and writes them into these object_ids via style-preserving deleteText(ALL)+insertText — identical to the economics layer. This file says WHERE; the proposal says WHAT. The slide itself is created ONCE in gold via narrative-slide2.gold-create.editplan.json with these exact IDs, then inherited by every gold copy. Never author prose; never invent object_ids.

background.note: Background is a full-bleed market image with a navy scrim for legibility; text sits above the scrim. No right-zone image box.

proof_strip.note: KPI chips removed 2026-06-22 (cross-slide redundancy + copy room). network_thesis.stats remains in narrative JSON for the economics sidecar and slide 4, but is NOT painted on slide 2.

positioning.sample: own the arrival, own the margin

thesis.sample: Your guests already arrive by boat. Navier makes that arrival the best part of the stay — and a margin line you own.

the_deal.sample: Minor brings 109 coastal-relevant properties and a captive guest base; Navier brings the silent foiling fleet proven in the live Maldives network. Together we turn every resort transfer into a branded, zero-emission signature.

your_world.sample_text: You operate 100+ coastal and island resorts where the last mile is water — and guests take the resort's boat.
Diesel speedboats and outsourced launches leak margin, fumes, and weather risk on the arrival guests remember first.
A branded electric hydrofoil fleet you control end-to-end — gateway pickups, inter-resort hops, and curated excursions.
Maldives is live at scale; Phuket, Bali, and Palm Jumeirah floors are grounded — captive economics, not contested mobility.

paint_protocol: Per-deck (after one-time gold-create): for each present pin, deleteText{objectId,textRange:ALL} then insertText{objectId,insertionIndex:0}. Skip pins where present=false (null beats confidently-wrong). If the deck still carries RETIRED_OBJECT_IDS, deleteObject them. No numbers are painted on slide 2; quantified proof lives on slide 4 + sidecar.
